Usage: memoriahub import [options] <folder>

One-shot import: register a folder and sync it immediately (alias for sync
<folder>)

Arguments:
  folder           Path to the folder to import

Options:
  -r, --recursive  Descend into sub-directories (default: false)
  --dry-run        Show what would be uploaded without actually uploading
                   (default: false)
  --circle <id>    Target circle ID (overrides active circle in config)
  -h, --help       display help for command
